newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bodies of Singapore Learjet crew members found.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of Singapore Learjet crew members found.

text.p: The bodies of two crew members of a Singapore Learjet which went missing over Thailand on Monday have been found, Singapore Airlines (SIA) said.
In a statement released late on Thursday, SIA said: "We have received confirmation from the authorities in Thailand that the bodies of the two crew members have been found."
SIA earlier reported that Thai searchers had spotted the wreckage of the training jet in a burned area of dense forest.
The search had begun within hours of the Learjet disappearing from radar screens on Monday afternoon.
An Australian pilot and a Singaporean trainee were aboard the Learjet 31 when it left the Thai resort island of Phuket for Ranong, 170 km (106 miles) farther north.
SIA has declined to name the 54-year-old Australian and the 28-year-old Singaporean at the request of their families.
